create_repo_HfApi: create a HfApi repository with a given name, visibility, and optional repo_type
upload_file_HfApi: upload a file to a Hugging Face Hub repository using HfApi.upload_file
upload_folder_HfApi: upload an entire folder to a Hugging Face Hub repository with HfApi.upload_folder
list_models_HfApi: list and search models on the Hugging Face Hub using HfApi.list_models
model_info_HfApi: retrieve detailed information about a model repository using HfApi.model_info
create_commit_HfApi: create a commit with add and delete operations on a Hugging Face Hub repository
upload_large_folder_HfApi: upload a large folder with many files to a Hugging Face Hub repository using HfApi.upload_large_folder
list_datasets_HfApi: list and filter datasets on the Hugging Face Hub using HfApi.list_datasets
list_spaces_HfApi: list and search spaces on the Hugging Face Hub using HfApi.list_spaces
create_discussion_HfApi: create a discussion or pull request on a Hugging Face Hub repository using HfApi.create_discussion
